subject.title: feat(subagents): add execution backend placement contract

question: Should v1 expose schema-valid `container` and `kubernetes` backend contracts before any non-local runner, lifecycle, credential, or isolation semantics are implemented?
rationale: These values create durable config and model-facing compatibility commitments across an execution security boundary; implementation review cannot safely choose their future meaning.

options.title: Narrow to local process
options.body: Expose only the implemented built-in local process backend and add remote types with their actual runner and security contracts later.

options.title: Approve reserved remote types
options.body: Keep container and Kubernetes schema values now and explicitly accept the forward compatibility and security-design commitment.

options.title: Pause for runtime design
options.body: Hold the slice until execution placement, worker protocol, lifecycle, and isolation are designed together.

recommendation.title: Narrow to local process
recommendation.body: Expose only the implemented built-in local process backend and add remote types with their actual runner and security contracts later.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the concrete subagent dispatch path that must enforce any execution-placement contract.
